rules: Paths are relative to the repository root. The owner of a file is the owner of the LONGEST matching prefix (carve-outs inside T01's tree are listed explicitly).

Write only inside your own paths. Shared contracts, shared dependencies (teacher-ui package.json + lockfile), root routing (teacher-ui/src/app), the shared API client (teacher-ui/src/api), the migration mechanism (classroom/server/db.py) and the server composition root are T01's.
Change requests to T01: proctoring/handoffs/<you>/DEPENDENCIES.txt (what, why, which fixture shows it). Contract changes are additive and versioned.
Server code plugs in through classroom.server.features (factory(ctx) -> feature). Routes only under the prefixes in route_reservations; tables only with your migration prefix.
Teacher UI code plugs in as a FeatureModule in teacher-ui/src/features/<your dir>/index.ts (auto-discovered, no shared file edits).
Student client code (C2) and CV modules (A02-A12) are NOT classroom paths: never edit them from a T-role.
Self-check before every push: python proctoring/classroom/coordination/verify_ownership.py --agent <Txx> --base <T01 baseline SHA>
No main, no force-push, no merging other roles' branches; T01 integrates.

T01.role: Coordinator: class server core, contracts, shared UI shell, simulator, migration mechanism
provides: python -m classroom.server (pairing, teacher PIN auth, heartbeat, event dedup, persistence, command bus, teacher stream, audio signaling relay, feature mounting)
teacher-ui shell: routing, login, typed API client, stream subscription, FeatureModule registry

T02.role: Class view: student cards, statuses, attention queue, filters

T03.role: History of episodes, clips, teacher decisions

T04.role: Exams, policies, teacher commands (policy layer on the T01 command bus)
consumes: feature hooks on_student_connected (welcome.exam override), on_student_message, on_student_disconnected, on_command_update, tick

T05.role: Audio link with a student and its signaling (WebRTC in LAN, no STUN/TURN)
consumes: commands audio_start/audio_stop via ctx.submit_command or POST /api/teacher/students/{id}/commands

not_classroom.C1: the global OWNERSHIP.json name of this role: C1 = T01 (same path proctoring/classroom/; T01 hands off in proctoring/handoffs/T01/)
not_classroom.C2: student uplink: proctoring/backend/proctor/uplink/ (other developer, global OWNERSHIP.json, branch codex/class-C2). Speaks qorgau.class.v1 to /ws/student.
not_classroom.A01..A12: local single-student product incl. CV and the student shell (global proctoring/coordination/OWNERSHIP.json)
